title: Edit Distance
description: Given two strings word1 and word2, return the minimum number of insertions, deletions, and character replacements needed to convert word1 into word2.

reference.use_case: Measuring how different two strings are as the minimum number of single-character edits, to suggest corrections or match near-duplicates.
system_examples: Spell checkers and 'did you mean' search suggestions
Lucene/Elasticsearch fuzzy queries — matching terms within a Levenshtein edit distance using Levenshtein automata
Record linkage — matching names and addresses with typos across databases
reference.explanation: dp[i][j] holds the distance between prefixes; each cell is a free match or 1 + the minimum of insert, delete, and replace, filled in O(m·n). Levenshtein distance underlies fuzzy search, spell correction, and record linkage.
